findings.finding: Public launcher allowed 1..128 while frozen smoke worker allows only 1..32.
findings.resolution: Public range changed to 1..32; user ceiling 128 recorded separately; no event/full adapter.
findings.closure: Final source read and rejection test source inspected; formal execution separate.

findings.finding: -B prevents bytecode writing but permits stale timestamp-valid bytecode reads, so sealed .py bytes did not necessarily match imported code.
findings.resolution: New empty create-only supervisor and worker cache prefixes; child -B -X pycache_prefix from startup; worker entry validates prefix; benchmark CLI uses fresh prefix.
findings.closure: Independent real counterexample and fresh-prefix recovery, then final source inspection.

findings.finding: Benchmark numerical imports occurred before install_limits.
findings.resolution: CLI-only install_limits before NumPy/project imports; helper import does not install limits/alarm.
findings.closure: Direct read of final benchmark SHA256 4b6f99e085aa016e0bbff3a67673ad3646b53bca793c1b6f7b9c9921547e3dd4.

findings.finding: Records appended in preexec_fn exist only in fork child copy.
findings.resolution: Receipt labels fork-local scope and records actual worker-entry rlimits; worker-main records retained by worker.

independently_executed_cache_probe.method: py_compile initial source; replace with same-size source; restore exact mtime/atime; run ordinary -B import and fresh-prefix -B import.
independently_executed_cache_probe.capture_scope: Actual process results from current-session tool return, transcribed here. This initial probe did not create a file-level stdout hash receipt.
independently_executed_cache_probe.counting: One audit counterexample with two subprocesses; overlaps later regression coverage and is not added to the test-suite count.
